items.name: Trump (Truth Social): 'We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed' - 'We've got their money ... and we've got their Strait'; Vance pulled off the Iran file
items.headline: Trump (Truth Social): 'We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed' - 'We've got their money ... and we've got their Strait'; Vance pulled off the Iran file
items.source: The National, 12 Nov 2026 (updated 14:14); CBS live 12 Nov 08:47 EST; Iran International liveblog 13:13 and 15:14 GMT; RFE/RL 13 Nov
items.claim: On Thursday 12 Nov Trump posted that the US no longer needs a deal with Iran ('Those days have long since passed'), claiming 'We've got their money, hundreds of billions of dollars, and we've got their Strait', and directed VP Vance - who had led the outreach and whom the WSJ had reported was weighing direct talks with Rezaei in Doha - to give his 'complete and total attention' to alleged corruption in Democratic-run states. WSJ adds Trump privately criticised the June MoU; an analyst (RFE/RL) says the Iran file has moved to Rubio and Hegseth. Oil erased an earlier decline and rallied ~3% on the post (CappNotes, The National). A reversal of the 'deal after the midterms' line; reads as diplomacy stepping back, not a strike.

items.name: Trump: Saudi Arabia asked me to 'let it be the way it is now for a while', UAE/Qatar/Kuwait agree - 'I'm not sure I agree with it'; says he won't hesitate to strike again
items.headline: Trump: Saudi Arabia asked me to 'let it be the way it is now for a while', UAE/Qatar/Kuwait agree - 'I'm not sure I agree with it'; says he won't hesitate to strike again
items.source: Middle East Eye live, 13 Nov 2026 07:32 GMT (Stephen A. Smith interview); Gulf News 13 Nov 10:18 GST; Al Jazeera liveblog 13 Nov
items.claim: In an interview with Stephen A. Smith aired 12-13 Nov Trump said Gulf allies asked Washington to hold off further large-scale attacks on Iran - 'Saudi Arabia has asked me to please just let it be the way it is now for a while' - with the UAE, Qatar and Kuwait preferring the same, adding 'I'm not sure I agree with it'; hours earlier he said he would not hesitate to order more military action. Gulf News frames the blockade continuing while diplomacy proceeds. (Context: 10 Nov he called a resumption of military action 'quite unlikely' for now but 'locked and loaded'.)

items.name: Ghalibaf to Al Jazeera: US asked Putin to arrange direct talks; Iran sent its response, 'ball is in America's court', does not want to continue the war
items.headline: Ghalibaf to Al Jazeera: US asked Putin to arrange direct talks; Iran sent its response, 'ball is in America's court', does not want to continue the war
items.source: Mediaite via Yahoo, 12 Nov 2026 21:48 UTC (AP); CBS live 12 Nov 14:26 EST; Middle East Eye live 13 Nov
items.claim: Parliament speaker and chief negotiator Ghalibaf told Al Jazeera that US officials, during a Moscow visit, asked Putin to get Iran to speak directly with Washington; the White House did not address the claim. Witkoff and Kushner were in Russia on Thursday 12 Nov for Ukraine talks, with no public sign Iran came up. On 13 Nov Ghalibaf added that Tehran does not want to continue the war, has sent a clear response to US demands with no reply, and that the 'ball is in America's court', accusing the US of a siege blocking food, trade and healthcare. (Update vs 11-12 file: Ghalibaf 'asked Putin to mediate' item - now with the Moscow-visit detail and Al Jazeera sourcing.)

items.name: Basij chief Taeb: Iran will decide 'the manner and agenda of any negotiations' only after its seven conditions are met; Baghaei warns third countries against joining US attacks or 'economic terrorism'
items.headline: Basij chief Taeb: Iran will decide 'the manner and agenda of any negotiations' only after its seven conditions are met; Baghaei warns third countries against joining US attacks or 'economic terrorism'
items.source: CBS live 12 Nov 2026 06:37 and 12:37 EST; Iran International liveblog 12 Nov 14:05 GMT (Insight); Middle East Eye live 12 Nov
items.claim: Hossein Taeb, Basij chief and former IRGC intelligence head, said 12 Nov that Iran will decide the manner and agenda of any negotiations only after its seven conditions are met, and described messages still moving between the sides via intermediaries (Iran International); the conditions have never been published but reportedly include ending the naval blockade, releasing frozen assets and halting fighting on all fronts. Foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei warned that any 'direct or indirect' aggression or 'economic terrorism' against Iran, including naval forces or logistical support from third countries, would be treated as hostile and unlawful.

items.name: Iran's Assembly of Experts: studying NPT withdrawal 'has become an unavoidable necessity' and 'a popular and national demand'
items.headline: Iran's Assembly of Experts: studying NPT withdrawal 'has become an unavoidable necessity' and 'a popular and national demand'
items.source: Newsquawk, 12 Nov 2026 12:03 UTC (Al Mayadeen); CBS live 12 Nov 09:40 EST; RFE/RL 13 Nov
items.claim: The clerical Assembly of Experts, which appoints the Supreme Leader, said on 12 Nov that studying withdrawal from the NPT has become an 'unavoidable necessity' and a national demand, amid a growing domestic debate about developing nuclear weapons; it does not set nuclear policy, so Newsquawk reads it as signalling at the lower end of the escalation ladder. Comes a day after Rezaei's 'not a single particle' leaves the country and as the IAEA reports it cannot locate or inspect the Isfahan enrichment plant.

items.name: IAEA confidential report: 'increasingly concerned' about uninspected Isfahan Fuel Enrichment Plant - location, safeguards status and nuclear material unknown; 'serious proliferation concern'
items.headline: IAEA confidential report: 'increasingly concerned' about uninspected Isfahan Fuel Enrichment Plant - location, safeguards status and nuclear material unknown; 'serious proliferation concern'
items.source: Reuters (Francois Murphy, Vienna) via Al-Monitor, 13 Nov 2026
items.claim: A confidential IAEA report seen by Reuters on 13 Nov says the agency is 'increasingly concerned' about the Isfahan Fuel Enrichment Plant, declared 12 June 2025 and never inspected (the planned 13 June visit was pre-empted by the bombing); the IAEA does not know its exact location, safeguards status or whether it holds nuclear material, and has had no access to any bombed site. Diplomats believe IFEP is in the Isfahan tunnel complex where Grossi said in March much of the near-weapons-grade stock sits. The report calls the lack of information a 'serious proliferation concern' to be fixed 'with the utmost urgency' and asks Iran to account for its HEU. Ahead of the Board of Governors' November session (date not given).

items.name: IRGC says it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to an 'enemy' strike on a Sirik telecom tower - first claimed attack on US assets in a Gulf state since early September; unverified
items.headline: IRGC says it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to an 'enemy' strike on a Sirik telecom tower - first claimed attack on US assets in a Gulf state since early September; unverified
items.source: RFE/RL, 13 Nov 2026; CBS live 13 Nov 02:39-03:31 EST; Gulf News 13 Nov; Middle East Eye live 13 Nov
items.claim: Late Thursday 12 Nov IRNA reported an 'enemy' military strike on Sirik, a Hormozgan port town hosting part of Iran's radar/communications network over the strait (attacker, damage and casualties unstated; residents heard explosions). On Friday 13 Nov the IRGC Aerospace Force said it 'targeted and destroyed' a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for 'enemy air aggression against a telecommunications tower in Sirik', calling it a 'serious warning' against 'aerial provocations and oil smuggling' in Hormuz and threatening a harsher response. Neither Washington nor Manama commented; Gulf News and CBS call it the first claimed attack on a US facility in a Gulf country since early September. Unverified.

items.name: Iran's army: two more tankers on fire after hitting mines east of the strait - four claimed in 24h; no UKMTO/Ambrey/CENTCOM confirmation of any
items.headline: Iran's army: two more tankers on fire after hitting mines east of the strait - four claimed in 24h; no UKMTO/Ambrey/CENTCOM confirmation of any
items.source: Arab News (AFP), 12 Nov 2026 18:39; CBS live 12 Nov 10:06 EST; Iran International 14:52 GMT; Reuters via Business Recorder 13 Nov
items.claim: Iran's army said on 12 Nov that two tankers 'in violation' east of the Strait caught fire after 'hitting a naval mine', blaming the US president; with the IRGC's two supertankers (>4m bbl, 'violent explosion' on a 'prohibited path', recorded 11-12 file) Iran now claims four tankers burning in 24 hours. No names, flags or positions; Reuters could not verify; no UKMTO, Ambrey, JMIC or CENTCOM confirmation in any fetched source; the US military says the strait's routes were cleared of mines and CTP-ISW sees no sign of successful re-mining. Windward logs no Hormuz incident for 12 Nov. (Update vs 11-12 file: IRGC two-supertanker claim.)

items.name: IRGC Navy: LNG tanker hit a mine and exploded on an 'unauthorised and dangerous route' south of the strait; unverified, no vessel named
items.headline: IRGC Navy: LNG tanker hit a mine and exploded on an 'unauthorised and dangerous route' south of the strait; unverified, no vessel named
items.source: Baird Maritime, 13 Nov 2026 10:22 (Reuters); CBS live 13 Nov 02:39 EST; Al Arabiya / Malay Mail 13 Nov
items.claim: The IRGC Navy said early Friday 13 Nov that an LNG tanker struck a naval mine and exploded after entering an 'unauthorised and dangerous' passage south of the Strait of Hormuz; no name, flag, operator or position given and no independent confirmation (UKMTO, Ambrey, JMIC, Qatar or CENTCOM) in fetched sources. Would be the first claimed LNG-carrier casualty in this sequence; hormuz.now shows zero AIS-visible LNG/LPG crossings in the past 7 days. Washington Institute tally: at least 10 ships hit in the first 10 days of November after 37 in October.

items.name: UKMTO confirms Wed 11 Nov Ras Al Khaimah strike: Liberia-flagged tanker Dominica Prosperity hit at 18:00 GMT, engine-room fire, 22 crew evacuated
items.headline: UKMTO confirms Wed 11 Nov Ras Al Khaimah strike: Liberia-flagged tanker Dominica Prosperity hit at 18:00 GMT, engine-room fire, 22 crew evacuated
items.source: Reuters via Arab News, 12 Nov 2026 15:38 UTC (updated 20:16); Insurance Journal 12 Nov; Gulf News 13 Nov; Iran International 12 Nov 13:22 GMT
items.claim: UKMTO said a vessel was hit by an unidentified projectile about 14nm NW of Ras Al Khaimah on Wednesday 11 Nov (Iran International: 18:00 GMT) with an engine-room fire and firefighting under way; Ambrey said it was struck at the stern while leaving the strait. Reuters names the ship as the Liberia-flagged oil tanker MT Dominica Prosperity (owner Haut Brion 56 Ltd, operator Sinokor Maritime, per MARISKS); India's shipping minister said all 22 crew (19 Indian) were evacuated and that the tanker was attacked while drifting off Mina Saqr. Update vs 11-12 file: the Ambrey 'outbound merchant vessel' item, now UKMTO-confirmed and named. CTP-ISW notes engine-room hits are increasing, suggesting more precise weapons.

items.name: Houthis claim strikes on a Saudi East-West pipeline pumping station, a Yanbu oil facility and an Aramco building in Riyadh; coalition reports two drones intercepted; no Saudi confirmation of damage
items.headline: Houthis claim strikes on a Saudi East-West pipeline pumping station, a Yanbu oil facility and an Aramco building in Riyadh; coalition reports two drones intercepted; no Saudi confirmation of damage
items.source: Cyprus Mail (Reuters), 12 Nov 2026 22:30; Iran International 12 Nov 17:32 GMT; CappNotes 12 Nov; Critical Threats 12 Nov
items.claim: On 12 Nov the Houthis said they attacked a pumping station on the East-West pipeline, an oil facility in Yanbu and an Aramco building in Riyadh (CTP also lists a claimed drone hit on a military cargo plane at Sharura airport); they did not say when. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two drones (Riyadh region, Eastern Province) without linking them to the claims; Saudi Arabia did not comment and no damage is confirmed. The pipeline carries ~4 mb/d to Yanbu (~4% of global supply), Riyadh's main Hormuz workaround; a September strike shut it ~11 days. CappNotes cites these claims as the main driver of Brent's +3.3% settle. Houthis deny firing at Mecca on Wednesday. Later on 12 Nov the UNSC unanimously renewed Yemen sanctions to 14 Nov 2027 and condemned Houthi escalation against Saudi Arabia; Al Jazeera 13 Nov: Riyadh and China discussing the Houthis.

items.name: Katz: he, Netanyahu and IDF chief Zamir are aligned on Iran policy - 'Israel's security is the central consideration'; Pezeshkian says US being brought 'to its knees'; Rezaei promises Aerospace Force 'surprises'
items.headline: Katz: he, Netanyahu and IDF chief Zamir are aligned on Iran policy - 'Israel's security is the central consideration'; Pezeshkian says US being brought 'to its knees'; Rezaei promises Aerospace Force 'surprises'
items.source: Iran International liveblog, 12 Nov 2026 15:51-17:41 GMT
items.claim: Israeli Defense Minister Katz said 12 Nov (17:41 GMT) that he, Netanyahu and military chief Eyal Zamir agree on Iran policy and that Israel's security is 'the central consideration' - read against Trump's same-day 'no deal needed' post and Israel's post-election coalition talks. Same afternoon: Pezeshkian said the US was being brought 'to its knees' and that efforts to isolate Tehran had failed (16:53 GMT); Rezaei said the IRGC Aerospace Force is ready to deliver new battlefield 'surprises' and respond without geographic limits (15:51 GMT). Rhetorical; no new policy content.
